verdict.rationale: Honeycomb publishes a pricing page with a free-forever plan and per-signal volume allowances: up to 20M events and up to 100M metrics data points per month. That gives some self-serve cost transparency without contacting sales. The evidence shows no dollar rates for paid tiers or overage pricing, so an SRE cannot actually forecast spend beyond the free tier from this pack. Missing for 10: published per-signal dollar rates for paid tiers, overage or scaling pricing, a cost calculator or estimation guidance, confirmation that larger tiers do not require a sales conversation, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can predict costs from transparent published per-signal pricing without talking to sales

citations.quote: Event Volume: Up to 20M per month Metrics Data Points: Up to 100M per month
